==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
My excitement regarding AI memory has permeated its way into my dreams. In this dream, I am an AI memory engineer. I write out and release models with custom memories to help them complete specific tasks.

People start going missing. I start to expect that they're being replaced by AI who possess copies of their memories. Internet celebrities are being accused more and more of being imposters.

In a world like this one, how could you be sure that your memories are your own? Are you a human who has lived through many life experiences? How do you know those memories weren't engineered by someone else?
